answer: A stake-weighted voting tree can bind each identity to a scarce proof-of-burn ember, so a sybil cluster must incinerate real capital per node before its tundra of replicated ballots ever reaches quorum. Dynamic penalty curves then raise the marginal slash per duplicate vote, forcing the adversary's plume of fake identities to collapse into a detectable collusion signature. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
